messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-cloud.com, sarah.wu@nebula.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Tiered reserve ops — weekly pipeline → fleet triage

Team — kicking off the weekly triage for tiered reserves. Attached is a one-page snapshot of next 90 days of weighted closes from current pipeline (20270630_pipeline_snapshot.csv) and a proposed slot-mapping for tiered models (tiered_model_slots.pdf). High level asks: 

1) Infra (Karthik / Ben): confirm which of the proposed slots we can realistically provision in month-1 vs month-2 given node lead times and existing reserved pools. If there are hard blockers, mark them in the attached PDF.

2) Finance (Laura): we need a quick check on committed vs. forecasted ARR for Nebula (deal NB-2027-0421). If we convert the midline scenario in the CSV, what does that do to our monthly burn and free-slot buffer?

3) Sales Ops (me): I'll consolidate answers into the weekly ops card and send signal to the sales rep to freeze the pilot timelines.

Goal: have a clear go/no-go for 3 tiered reserve allocations (Pilot, Growth, Enterprise) by EoD. Quick cadence: 2x bullets per person + any hard dependencies.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: 20270630_pipeline_snapshot.csv (csv), tiered_model_slots.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered reserve ops — weekly pipeline → fleet triage

Thanks, Tessa. Quick infra read:

- Short answer: Pilot & Growth tiers look feasible for month-1 if we reuse two existing Reserved GPU pools (r-pool-3 and r-pool-5) and lean on burst slots for the first 2 weeks. Enterprise tier needs a 6–8 week lead unless the customer accepts mixed-capacity (quantized variants) for initial ramp.

- Risks / blockers: one of the r-pools is itself expected to be consumed by a scheduled internal training job the week of 7/11 — I put a note in the attached PDF. If that training can't be deferred we need to: (a) shift Pilot to burst-only for week-28; or (b) accelerate procurement of 2x A100s (lead time ~5 weeks).

Action items (infra):
- Ben: can you validate slot-level mapping in tiered_model_slots.pdf and flag any oversubscription? (ben_carter)
- Karthik: I'll open a capacity request ticket and tag finance for budget hit.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 18:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered reserve ops — weekly pipeline → fleet triage

Adding finance perspective: I looked at the midline and conservative cases in the CSV. Key points:

- If midline closes as-is, Nebula moves from Pilot → Growth in month-2. That increases committed spend by $38k/mo which we can absorb under current Reserved Capacity budget assuming 2 things: (1) we can repurpose r-pool-5 for 4 weeks as Karthik suggested; and (2) no other midline deals flip to enterprise in the same window.

- If enterprise ramp happens in month-1 we need an approval for incremental committed GPU capacity; suggest we keep that as a separate finance review (I can prep a one-slide ask).

Quick asks from finance:
- Ben: please attach a simple mapping of per-tier expected monthly spend (sum of reserved amortized + burst estimate) so we can model cash flow for July–Sep.
- Tessa: please confirm whether Nebula expects a hard go-live date or flexible ramp — procurement email in CC might have that answer.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Manager, Revenue Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 19:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered reserve ops — weekly pipeline → fleet triage

Thanks — quick slot validation attached (small table added to the PDF). TL;DR:

- Pilot: map to 4x T4-equivalent burst slots + 1 reserved slot (available immediately).
- Growth: map to 8x A10-equivalent reserved slots — two can be pulled from r-pool-3 this week; remaining will need either short-term burst or a temporary pool reassign.
- Enterprise: 24x A100-equivalent — needs procurement path or customer accepts quantized variants.

I've attached a tiny cost spreadsheet excerpt in the Drive link (also added to related_links). If Karthik can confirm the scheduled training job is movable, month-1 for Pilot+Growth is green. Otherwise we default to: Pilot month-1, Growth month-2.
